editorial:
Imagine you are searching for your missing brother and you end up in a creepy, empty warehouse. That is exactly where you start in this flick. You follow a young woman who finds a pile of old VHS tapes that hold some scary secrets. The vibe is very tense from the start, making you feel like you are trapped right there with her. It uses a cool mix of regular filming and shaky found-footage styles that keep you on edge. You will feel the panic as she is forced to watch these cursed videos to find any clue about her brother.

The acting is top-notch and the twists actually surprise you instead of being obvious. While some of the slow parts in the middle might drag, the scary payoffs are totally worth it. If you love movies that play with your head, you need to see this. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the gritty details. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move because the picture quality is stunning.
endingExplained: In the final scene, you find out that the tapes were not just recordings, but a way to swap souls. As the woman finishes the last video, the monster from the screen pulls her inside the TV. Her brother finally walks out of the warehouse, but he is not actually her brother. It is the demon wearing his skin. The movie ends with the real girl trapped forever in the static of the VHS tape.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves found-footage scares and twist endings.
